primary.title: Res Gestae Divi Augusti
primary.author: Augustus
primary.rationale: Augustus's own account of his achievements, a foundational primary source for his reign. Often translated and included in collections of Roman history.

primary.title: The Deeds of the Divine Augustus
primary.author: Augustus
primary.rationale: This is the English translation of the Res Gestae Divi Augusti, a key autobiographical statement by Augustus.

secondary.title: Augustus: The Life of Rome's First Emperor
secondary.author: Adrian Goldsworthy
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive and well-regarded biography of Augustus by a prominent historian of antiquity, published by a major academic press.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to the Age of Augustus
secondary.author: John F. Drinkwater and Bill Leadbetter
secondary.rationale: A collection of scholarly essays covering various aspects of Augustus's life, reign, and the Augustan age, from a leading academic publisher.

secondary.title: Augustan Rome
secondary.author: Andrew Wallace-Hadrill
secondary.rationale: An influential study that examines the social and cultural aspects of Augustan Rome, offering a critical perspective on the period.

suggestions.notes: Primary sources are limited to Augustus's own writings, with the Res Gestae being the most significant. Secondary sources focus on modern scholarly interpretations of his life and reign.
